pages.text: $(bold)Woven Jute Sack$()$(br)Right-click poultry (any size) or another animals young to bag it; right-click again to release.

$(bold)Fishing Net$()$(br)Set it in water as a fishing net; every so often a live aquatic creature spawns just above its surface - ocean biomes yield sea catch, other biomes yield freshwater. Players can walk straight through it; other creatures cannot.
